response.sql: SELECT mt.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS AvgBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name;

assumptions.assumption: The threshold is exclusive: only tracks with Bytes strictly greater than 10323804 are kept. Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded by the filter.
Media types are grouped by name, so two media types sharing a name are combined into one row. No track has Milliseconds = 0; in SQLite such a division yields NULL and is ignored by AVG.
Averages are taken over tracks, not weighted by invoice line sales, and the 'list price' is Track.UnitPrice.

alternatives.interpretation: The threshold is inclusive: keep tracks whose file size is at least 10323804 bytes, so a track of exactly that size is included.
